lines.speaker: S1
lines.english: Good morning! Fresh apples, picked at dawn. Two coins a basket.
lines.text: Good morning! Fresh apples, picked at dawn. Two coins a basket.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.english: Two coins? They look a little bruised to me.
lines.text: Two coins? They look a little bruised to me.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.english: Bruised? Those are freckles. Apples have freckles too.
lines.text: Bruised? Those are freckles. Apples have freckles too.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.english: Then the freckles cost one coin, and the apples another.
lines.text: Then the freckles cost one coin, and the apples another.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.english: Ah, you are a hard woman. One and a half, and I add a pear.
lines.text: Ah, you are a hard woman. One and a half, and I add a pear.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.english: One coin and the pear, and I come back tomorrow.
lines.text: One coin and the pear, and I come back tomorrow.

lines.speaker: S1
lines.english: Every day you come back, and every day I lose money. Fine. One coin.
lines.text: Every day you come back, and every day I lose money. Fine. One coin.

lines.speaker: S2
lines.english: You never lose money. Thank you, old friend.
lines.text: You never lose money. Thank you, old friend.
